pages.text: The $(item)Preserving Jar$() works slowly with its lid closed: pickles in vinegar, sauerkraut, kimchi, a $(item)sourdough starter$() from flour and water, and the cultures brewers need. Right-click to open or close the lid.
Where it stands matters for some: koji grows only somewhere warm, lager yeast only somewhere cold (beside ice). Wine left in an open jar with no yeast turns to vinegar.
